items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: He used to play in the Florentine G-GRILL (phonetic) group... naturally they got a few good jazz numbers, because they had a guy like Sidney Gibbon (phonetic), Bechet, the soprano player.

ctx.x: Anyway, I'm sorry. I got distracted because I'm thinking Lucky Roberts and Dick Dick Jazz Hangert (phonetic), but anyway, you -- you were starting to play duets and went to Noble Sissle in '31.

I went to Noble Sissle -- late '31, I went to Noble -- '32, in '32, I think. He used to play in the Florentine G-GRILL (phonetic) group, Park Center Hotel. They call it Park Sheraton today. So there I play -- he play like a kind of -- kind of society called a band with a match -- naturally they got a few good jazz numbers, because they had a guy like Sidney Gibbon (phonetic), Bechet, the soprano player.
